files.navigation.css: .nav-sidebar{--inset:12px;display:flex;flex-direction:column;gap:20px;width:260px;max-width:100%;height:100%;min-height:0;overflow:auto;padding:16px;background:#f5f7fa;font:14px system-ui;color:#263344}.nav-sidebar section h2{margin:0;padding:0 var(--inset) 8px;font-size:12px;font-weight:650}.nav-sidebar nav section+section{margin-top:24px}.nav-sidebar ul{list-style:none;margin:0;padding:0}.nav-sidebar li button{display:grid;grid-template-columns:18px minmax(0,1fr) auto;gap:8px;align-items:center;width:100%;min-height:40px;text-align:left;padding:8px var(--inset);border:0;background:transparent;border-radius:6px;color:inherit;font:inherit}.nav-sidebar [aria-current=page]{background:#dfe8fb;font-weight:650}.nav-sidebar button:disabled{opacity:.55;cursor:not-allowed}.nav-unavailable{font-size:10px}.nav-sidebar .workspace-summary{padding:var(--inset);background:#e8edf4;border-radius:6px}.nav-sidebar .workspace-summary h2{padding:0}.workspace-summary p{margin:8px 0 0}.nav-sidebar footer{margin-top:auto;display:flex;gap:8px}.nav-sidebar footer button{padding:8px 12px;font:inherit;border:1px solid #b5bfcc;border-radius:5px;background:white}.nav-sidebar button:focus-visible{outline:2px solid #2457c5;outline-offset:2px}
